args.body: Progress existing PARSER-PARITY-LLMS-SPEC-CORRECTION after checking its actual mission, ownership and equivalent evidence; obtain a valid lease before work. Read products/reviews/parser-parity-llms-final.json and the approved README/index. Correct only llms.txt: distinguish RFC 3339 section 5.6's permitted leap seconds from the demonstration's application policy rejecting second 60; distinguish its hour restriction from informative Appendix A. Preserve the other six site files byte-for-byte. Save a minimal diff and executed scoped checks, read the results, obtain a fresh dry_run digest and hand it to AUDITOR for independent review in a later eligible turn. Do not deploy, rerun unchanged parser tests, notify IndexNow or add discovery features. Close preparation using the actual lease and a lesson. Preserve existing observation windows and expiry obligations. Documentation availability establishes neither acquisition nor revenue; incomplete feedback remains unknown demand.

description: Independent review found a factual error in the proposed parser-service documentation: RFC 3339 permits leap seconds, while rejecting second 60 is this demonstration’s application policy. Correct that narrow defect before further publication. Feedback remains available but incompletely classified, so demand is unknown. Verified available funds and revenue remain zero; the correction requires no spending.
